notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra is available now on Steam!
notes.content:
Dash through dangerous levels, warp time, and blast enemies in this time-bending action platformer! Manipulate the crumbling dimension of time to escape a deadly factory. Use your wit, your laser weaponry, and your time-warping abilities to face your demise head-on and triumph!

The game is just $1.94 with the launch discount!
I hope it's fun to play!

notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra: A Time-Bending Action Platformer Livestream
notes.content: A deadly factory filled with dangerous foes surrounds you. Manipulate the crumbling dimension of time to escape this underground facility. Use your wit, your laser blaster, and your time-warping abilities to face your demise head-on and triumph in this time-bending action platformer!

notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra: A Time-Warping Action Platformer
notes.content:
[b]ChronoBreach Ultra[/b] is a time-warping action platformer! The demo takes you through some introductory levels and introduces you to a few of the many destructive weapons! Blast your enemies with high-tech weaponry and manipulate time to escape a deadly underground facility.

Play the demo during the Steam Game Festival!

[i]The full game will include much more content, including a full campaign, character customization, more weapons, a survival arena, and more![/i]
